name: eden-press-corpus-gen
description: Dev tooling (not shipped). Generates the Marp golden conformance corpus (CONF-01) by rendering representative Markdown through the real @marp-team/marp-core npm package — the oracle — and extracts the three official themes' fully-compiled CSS (CORE-01) for verbatim go:embed. Regenerate with `npm ci && node gen.mjs`; extract themes with `npm ci && node extract-themes.mjs`. Output: conformance/corpus/cases/<id>/{input.md,options.json,expected.html,expected.css} and themes/{default,gaia,uncover}.css + themes/browser-fit.js.
